## 📚 已购图书模块设计方案

### 一、需求分析

根据您提供的表格截图，已购图书模块需要管理以下字段：

| 字段名 | 说明 | 类型 |
|--------|------|------|
| 记录号 | 图书唯一标识（主键） | BIGINT |
| 著者 | 作者名称 | VARCHAR |
| 题名 | 书名 | VARCHAR |
| ISBN | 国际标准书号 | VARCHAR |
| 出版社 | 出版社名称 | VARCHAR |
| 出版年 | 出版年份 | VARCHAR |
| 版本 | 版本号 | VARCHAR |
| 总册数 | 该书总共有多少册 | INT |
| 有效册数 | 当前可用的册数 | INT |

### 二、设计思路

**思考问题**：在开始编码之前，请您思考一下：
1. 这个模块与现有的 `purchased_problem_books`（已购问题图书）有什么区别？
2. 您是否需要批量导入功能（从 Excel 导入馆藏数据）？
3. 是否需要与书单检测模块关联（检测结果显示是否在馆藏中）？

---

### 三、模块结构设计

参考现有的 `problembook` 模块，我们需要创建以下文件：

```
library-management-backend/src/main/java/com/library/management/module/
└── purchasedbook/                    # 已购图书模块（新建）
    ├── controller/
    │   └── PurchasedBookController.java
    ├── dto/
    │   ├── PurchasedBookDTO.java
    │   ├── PurchasedBookCreateRequest.java
    │   ├── PurchasedBookUpdateRequest.java
    │   ├── PurchasedBookQueryRequest.java
    │   └── PurchasedBookExcelDTO.java
    ├── entity/
    │   └── PurchasedBook.java
    ├── mapper/
    │   └── PurchasedBookMapper.java
    └── service/
        ├── PurchasedBookService.java
        └── impl/
            └── PurchasedBookServiceImpl.java
```

---

### 四、数据库表设计

首先，我需要为已购图书创建一个新的数据库表。让我为您设计：

```sql
-- 已购图书表（馆藏图书）
CREATE TABLE purchased_books (
    record_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '记录号（主键，自增）',
    author VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '著者（作者）',
    book_name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT '题名（书名）',
    isbn VARCHAR(20) COMMENT 'ISBN',
    publisher VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '出版社',
    publish_year VARCHAR(10) COMMENT '出版年',
    edition VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '版本',
    total_copies INT DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '总册数',
    available_copies INT DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '有效册数',
    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人用户ID',
    create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_by BIGINT COMMENT '更新人用户ID',
    update_time DATETIME COMMENT '更新时间'
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='已购图书表（馆藏图书）';
```

---

## 📚 馆藏图书模块设计方案

### 一、整体设计思路

根据您的需求，我将设计一个统一的**馆藏图书表**，通过字段区分"正常馆藏"和"问题图书"：

| 字段名 | 中文名 | 类型 | 说明 |
|--------|--------|------|------|
| barcode | 条码 | VARCHAR(50) | **主键**，图书唯一标识 |
| book_name | 题名 | VARCHAR(500) | 必填 |
| author | 著者 | VARCHAR(200) | |
| isbn | ISBN | VARCHAR(20) | |
| publisher | 出版社 | VARCHAR(200) | |
| publish_year | 出版年 | VARCHAR(10) | |
| branch_library | 分馆 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| call_number | 索书号 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| price | 单价 | DECIMAL(10,2) | |
| batch | 批次 | VARCHAR(50) | |
| is_stored | 是否入库 | TINYINT | 0-否，1-是 |
| library_location | 馆藏院舍 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| shelf_location | 书架位置 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| duplicate_flag | 重复标记 | TINYINT | 0-否，1-是 |
| **is_problem** | **是否问题图书** | TINYINT | 0-正常，1-问题图书 |
| problem_reason | 问题原因 | TEXT | 问题图书时填写 |

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,95 @@
- 
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- 馆藏图书表结构 (collection_books)
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- 功能：存储图书馆馆藏图书信息，包括正常馆藏和问题图书
+ -- 创建日期：2025-12-05
+ -- =====================================================
+ 
+ -- 删除旧表（如果存在）
+ DROP TABLE IF EXISTS collection_books;
+ 
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- 创建馆藏图书表
+ -- =====================================================
+ CREATE TABLE collection_books (
+     -- 主键：条码（图书唯一标识）
+     barcode VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY COMMENT &#39;条码（主键，图书唯一标识）&#39;,
+     
+     -- 基本信息
+     book_name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT &#39;题名（书名）&#39;,
+     author VARCHAR(200) COMMENT &#39;著者（作者）&#39;,
+     isbn VARCHAR(20) COMMENT &#39;ISBN&#39;,
+     publisher VARCHAR(200) COMMENT &#39;出版社&#39;,
+     publish_year VARCHAR(10) COMMENT &#39;出版年&#39;,
+     
+     -- 馆藏信息
+     branch_library VARCHAR(100) COMMENT &#39;分馆&#39;,
+     call_number VARCHAR(100) COMMENT &#39;索书号&#39;,
+     price DECIMAL(10, 2) COMMENT &#39;单价&#39;,
+     batch VARCHAR(50) COMMENT &#39;批次&#39;,
+     
+     -- 入库状态
+     is_stored TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1 COMMENT &#39;是否入库：0-否，1-是&#39;,
+     
+     -- 馆藏位置（分为两个字段）
+     library_location VARCHAR(100) COMMENT &#39;馆藏院舍&#39;,
+     shelf_location VARCHAR(100) COMMENT &#39;书架位置&#39;,
+     
+     -- 重复标记
+     duplicate_flag TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT &#39;重复标记：0-否，1-是&#39;,
+     
+     -- 问题图书标记
+     is_problem TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT &#39;是否问题图书：0-正常馆藏，1-问题图书&#39;,
+     problem_type VARCHAR(100) COMMENT &#39;问题类型&#39;,
+     problem_reason TEXT COMMENT &#39;问题原因/备注&#39;,
+     
+     -- 审计字段
+     created_by BIGINT COMMENT &#39;创建人用户ID&#39;,
+     create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT &#39;创建时间&#39;,
+     updated_by BIGINT COMMENT &#39;更新人用户ID&#39;,
+     update_time DATETIME ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT &#39;更新时间&#39;,
+     
+     -- 外键约束
+     CONSTRAINT fk_cb_creator FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES sys_user(user_id),
+     CONSTRAINT fk_cb_updater FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES sys_user(user_id)
+ ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT=&#39;馆藏图书表&#39;;
+ 
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- 创建索引
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- ISBN 索引（用于检索）
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_isbn ON collection_books(isbn);
+ 
+ -- 书名索引（支持模糊查询）
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_book_name ON collection_books(book_name(255));
+ 
+ -- 作者索引
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_author ON collection_books(author);
+ 
+ -- 出版社索引
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_publisher ON collection_books(publisher);
+ 
+ -- 分馆索引
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_branch_library ON collection_books(branch_library);
+ 
+ -- 索书号索引
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_call_number ON collection_books(call_number);
+ 
+ -- 是否问题图书索引（用于区分馆藏图书和问题图书）
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_is_problem ON collection_books(is_problem);
+ 
+ -- 批次索引
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_batch ON collection_books(batch);
+ 
+ -- 入库状态索引
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cb_is_stored ON collection_books(is_stored);
+ 
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- 说明
+ -- =====================================================
+ -- 1. 条码(barcode)作为主键，确保每本书的唯一性
+ -- 2. is_problem 字段区分正常馆藏(0)和问题图书(1)
+ -- 3. 馆藏位置分为：library_location(馆藏院舍) 和 shelf_location(书架位置)
+ -- 4. 支持 Excel 批量导入导出
+ -- =====================================================
+ 
```

```diff
+ 
+     /**
```

```diff
+ 
+     private final CollectionBookMapper collectionBookMapper;
+ 
+     @Override
+     public Page&lt;CollectionBookDTO&gt; queryBooks(CollectionBookQueryRequest request) {
+         // 1. 创建分页对象
+         Page&lt;CollectionBook&gt; page = new Page&lt;&gt;(request.getPageNum(), request.getPageSize());
+ 
+         // 2. 构建查询条件
+         LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;CollectionBook&gt; queryWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
+ 
+         // 条码精确查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getBarcode())) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getBarcode, request.getBarcode());
+         }
+         // 题名模糊查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getBookName())) {
+             queryWrapper.like(CollectionBook::getBookName, request.getBookName());
+         }
+         // 著者模糊查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getAuthor())) {
+             queryWrapper.like(CollectionBook::getAuthor, request.getAuthor());
+         }
+         // ISBN 精确查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getIsbn())) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getIsbn, request.getIsbn());
+         }
+         // 出版社模糊查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getPublisher())) {
+             queryWrapper.like(CollectionBook::getPublisher, request.getPublisher());
+         }
+         // 出版年精确查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getPublishYear())) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getPublishYear, request.getPublishYear());
+         }
+         // 分馆精确查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getBranchLibrary())) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getBranchLibrary, request.getBranchLibrary());
+         }
+         // 索书号模糊查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getCallNumber())) {
+             queryWrapper.like(CollectionBook::getCallNumber, request.getCallNumber());
+         }
+         // 批次精确查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getBatch())) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getBatch, request.getBatch());
+         }
+         // 是否入库精确查询
+         if (request.getIsStored() != null) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getIsStored, request.getIsStored());
+         }
+         // 馆藏院舍模糊查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getLibraryLocation())) {
+             queryWrapper.like(CollectionBook::getLibraryLocation, request.getLibraryLocation());
+         }
+         // 重复标记精确查询
+         if (request.getDuplicateFlag() != null) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getDuplicateFlag, request.getDuplicateFlag());
+         }
+         // 是否问题图书精确查询（关键条件，用于区分馆藏图书和问题图书列表）
+         if (request.getIsProblem() != null) {
+             queryWrapper.eq(CollectionBook::getIsProblem, request.getIsProblem());
+         }
+         // 问题类型模糊查询
+         if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getProblemType())) {
+             queryWrapper.like(CollectionBook::getProblemType, request.getProblemType());
+         }
+ 
+         // 3. 按创建时间倒序排列
+         queryWrapper.orderByDesc(CollectionBook::getCreateTime);
+ 
+         // 4. 执行分页查询
+         Page&lt;CollectionBook&gt; resultPage = collectionBookMapper.selectPage(page, queryWrapper);
+ 
+         // 5. 转换为 DTO
+         Page&lt;CollectionBookDTO&gt; dtoPage = new Page&lt;&gt;(resultPage.getCurrent(), resultPage.getSize(), resultPage.getTotal());
+         List&lt;CollectionBookDTO&gt; dtoList = resultPage.getRecords().stream()
+                 .map(this::convertToDTO)
+                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
+         dtoPage.setRecords(dtoList);
+ 
+         return dtoPage;
+     }

+                 @Override
+                 public void invoke(CollectionBookExcelDTO data, AnalysisContext context) {
+                     rowIndex++;
+                     try {
+                         // 校验必填字段

+                             errors.add(&quot;第&quot; + rowIndex + &quot;行：条码不能为空&quot;);
+                             return;

+                         if (!StringUtils.hasText(data.getBookName())) {

+

+                             errors.add(&quot;第&quot; + rowIndex + &quot;行：条码已存在 - &quot; + data.getBarcode());
+                             return;
+                         }
+ 
+                         // 转换为实体
+                         CollectionBook book = convertFromExcelDTO(data);
+                         book.setCreatedBy(createdBy);
+                         book.setCreateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
+ 
+                         successList.add(book);
+                     } catch (Exception e) {
+                         errors.add(&quot;第&quot; + rowIndex + &quot;行：数据格式错误 - &quot; + e.getMessage());
+                     }
+                 }
+ 
+                 @Override
+                 public void doAfterAllAnalysed(AnalysisContext context) {
+                     // 批量插入成功的数据
+                     if (!successList.isEmpty()) {
+                         for (CollectionBook book : successList) {
+                             collectionBookMapper.insert(book);
+                         }
+                     }
+                 }
+             }).sheet().doRead();
+ 
+         } catch (IOException e) {
+             log.error(&quot;导入馆藏图书失败&quot;, e);
+             throw new BusinessException(&quot;读取Excel文件失败：&quot; + e.getMessage());
+         }
+ 
+         result.put(&quot;successCount&quot;, successList.size());
+         result.put(&quot;errorCount&quot;, errors.size());
+         result.put(&quot;errors&quot;, errors);
+ 
+         log.info(&quot;导入馆藏图书完成，成功：{}，失败：{}&quot;, successList.size(), errors.size());
```

```diff
+             只能上传 xlsx/xls 文件，请先下载模板填写后上传

+         &lt;el-button type=&quot;primary&quot; :loading=&quot;importLoading&quot; @click=&quot;handleImportSubmit&quot;&gt;确定导入&lt;/el-button&gt;
+       &lt;/template&gt;

+       &lt;el-form :model=&quot;markProblemForm&quot; label-width=&quot;100px&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;el-form-item label=&quot;问题类型&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;el-input v-model=&quot;markProblemForm.problemType&quot; placeholder=&quot;请输入问题类型&quot; /&gt;
+         &lt;/el-form-item&gt;
+         &lt;el-form-item label=&quot;问题原因&quot;&gt;
+           &lt;el-input v-model=&quot;markProblemForm.problemReason&quot; type=&quot;textarea&quot; :rows=&quot;4&quot; placeholder=&quot;请输入问题原因&quot; /&gt;
+         &lt;/el-form-item&gt;
+       &lt;/el-form&gt;
+       &lt;template #footer&gt;
+         &lt;el-button @click=&quot;markProblemDialogVisible = false&quot;&gt;取消&lt;/el-button&gt;
+         &lt;el-button type=&quot;primary&quot; :loading=&quot;markProblemLoading&quot; @click=&quot;handleMarkProblemSubmit&quot;&gt;确定&lt;/el-button&gt;
+       &lt;/template&gt;

+ 
+ &lt;script setup&gt;
+ import { ref, reactive, onMounted } from &#39;vue&#39;
+ import { ElMessage, ElMessageBox } from &#39;element-plus&#39;
+ import { Search, Refresh, Plus, Upload, Download, Document, Delete, UploadFilled } from &#39;@element-plus/icons-vue&#39;
+ import {
+   getCollectionBookList,
+   createCollectionBook,
+   updateCollectionBook,
+   deleteCollectionBook,
+   deleteBatchCollectionBooks,
+   importCollectionBooks,
+   exportCollectionBooks,
+   downloadCollectionBookTemplate,
+   markAsProblem
+ } from &#39;@/api/collectionBook&#39;
+ 
+ // 搜索表单
+ const searchForm = reactive({
+   barcode: &#39;&#39;,
+   bookName: &#39;&#39;,
+   author: &#39;&#39;,
+   isbn: &#39;&#39;,
+   publisher: &#39;&#39;,
+   branchLibrary: &#39;&#39;,
+   batch: &#39;&#39;,
+   isStored: null,
+   isProblem: 0  // 只查询正常馆藏（非问题图书）
+ })
+ 
+ // 分页
+ const pagination = reactive({
+   pageNum: 1,
+   pageSize: 10,
+   total: 0
+ })
+ 
+ // 表格数据
+ const tableData = ref([])
+ const loading = ref(false)
+ const selectedRows = ref([])
+ 
+ // 对话框
+ const dialogVisible = ref(false)
+ const dialogType = ref(&#39;add&#39;)
+ const formRef = ref(null)
+ const submitLoading = ref(false)
+ 
+ // 表单数据
+ const formData = reactive({
+   barcode: &#39;&#39;,
+   bookName: &#39;&#39;,
+   author: &#39;&#39;,
+   isbn: &#39;&#39;,
+   publisher: &#39;&#39;,
+   publishYear: &#39;&#39;,
+   branchLibrary: &#39;&#39;,
+   callNumber: &#39;&#39;,
+   price: null,
+   batch: &#39;&#39;,
+   isStored: 1,
+   libraryLocation: &#39;&#39;,
+   shelfLocation: &#39;&#39;,
+   duplicateFlag: 0
+ })
+ 
+ // 表单校验规则
+ const formRules = {
+   barcode: [
+     { required: true, message: &#39;请输入条码&#39;, trigger: &#39;blur&#39; },
+     { max: 50, message: &#39;条码长度不能超过50个字符&#39;, trigger: &#39;blur&#39; }
+   ],
+   bookName: [
+     { required: true, message: &#39;请输入题名&#39;, trigger: &#39;blur&#39; },
+     { max: 500, message: &#39;题名长度不能超过500个字符&#39;, trigger: &#39;blur&#39; }
+   ]
+ }
+ 
+ // 导入对话框
+ const importDialogVisible = ref(false)
+ const importLoading = ref(false)
+ const uploadRef = ref(null)
+ const importFile = ref(null)
+ 
+ // 标记问题对话框
+ const markProblemDialogVisible = ref(false)
+ const markProblemLoading = ref(false)
+ const markProblemForm = reactive({
+   barcode: &#39;&#39;,
+   problemType: &#39;&#39;,
+   problemReason: &#39;&#39;
+ })
+ 
+ // 加载列表数据
+ const loadData = async () =&gt; {
+   loading.value = true
+   try {
+     const params = {
+       ...searchForm,
+       pageNum: pagination.pageNum,
+       pageSize: pagination.pageSize
+     }
+     const res = await getCollectionBookList(params)
+     if (res.code === 200) {
+       tableData.value = res.data.records || []
+       pagination.total = res.data.total || 0
+     }
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;加载数据失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;加载数据失败&#39;)
+   } finally {
+     loading.value = false
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 搜索
+ const handleSearch = () =&gt; {
+   pagination.pageNum = 1
+   loadData()
+ }
+ 
+ // 重置搜索
+ const handleReset = () =&gt; {
+   searchForm.barcode = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.bookName = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.author = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.isbn = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.publisher = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.branchLibrary = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.batch = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.isStored = null
+   handleSearch()
+ }
+ 
+ // 分页
+ const handleSizeChange = (val) =&gt; {
+   pagination.pageSize = val
+   loadData()
+ }
+ 
+ const handleCurrentChange = (val) =&gt; {
+   pagination.pageNum = val
+   loadData()
+ }
+ 
+ // 多选
+ const handleSelectionChange = (selection) =&gt; {
+   selectedRows.value = selection
+ }
+ 
+ // 新增
+ const handleAdd = () =&gt; {
+   dialogType.value = &#39;add&#39;
+   Object.keys(formData).forEach(key =&gt; {
+     if (key === &#39;isStored&#39;) {
+       formData[key] = 1
+     } else if (key === &#39;duplicateFlag&#39;) {
+       formData[key] = 0
+     } else if (key === &#39;price&#39;) {
+       formData[key] = null
+     } else {
+       formData[key] = &#39;&#39;
+     }
+   })
+   dialogVisible.value = true
+ }
+ 
+ // 编辑
+ const handleEdit = (row) =&gt; {
+   dialogType.value = &#39;edit&#39;
+   Object.keys(formData).forEach(key =&gt; {
+     formData[key] = row[key]
+   })
+   dialogVisible.value = true
+ }
+ 
+ // 提交表单
+ const handleSubmit = async () =&gt; {
+   if (!formRef.value) return
+   await formRef.value.validate(async (valid) =&gt; {
+     if (valid) {
+       submitLoading.value = true
+       try {
+         if (dialogType.value === &#39;add&#39;) {
+           await createCollectionBook(formData)
+           ElMessage.success(&#39;新增成功&#39;)
+         } else {
+           await updateCollectionBook(formData)
+           ElMessage.success(&#39;修改成功&#39;)
+         }
+         dialogVisible.value = false
+         loadData()
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error(&#39;提交失败:&#39;, error)
+         ElMessage.error(error.message || &#39;操作失败&#39;)
+       } finally {
+         submitLoading.value = false
+       }
+     }
+   })
+ }
+ 
+ // 删除
+ const handleDelete = (row) =&gt; {
+   ElMessageBox.confirm(&#96;确定要删除条码为&quot;${row.barcode}&quot;的图书吗？&#96;, &#39;提示&#39;, {
+     confirmButtonText: &#39;确定&#39;,
+     cancelButtonText: &#39;取消&#39;,
+     type: &#39;warning&#39;
+   }).then(async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       await deleteCollectionBook(row.barcode)
+       ElMessage.success(&#39;删除成功&#39;)
+       loadData()
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error(&#39;删除失败:&#39;, error)
+       ElMessage.error(&#39;删除失败&#39;)
+     }
+   }).catch(() =&gt; {})
+ }
+ 
+ // 批量删除
+ const handleBatchDelete = () =&gt; {
+   if (selectedRows.value.length === 0) {
+     ElMessage.warning(&#39;请先选择要删除的数据&#39;)
+     return
+   }
+   ElMessageBox.confirm(&#96;确定要删除选中的 ${selectedRows.value.length} 条数据吗？&#96;, &#39;提示&#39;, {
+     confirmButtonText: &#39;确定&#39;,
+     cancelButtonText: &#39;取消&#39;,
+     type: &#39;warning&#39;
+   }).then(async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const barcodes = selectedRows.value.map(item =&gt; item.barcode)
+       await deleteBatchCollectionBooks(barcodes)
+       ElMessage.success(&#39;批量删除成功&#39;)
+       loadData()
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error(&#39;批量删除失败:&#39;, error)
+       ElMessage.error(&#39;批量删除失败&#39;)
+     }
+   }).catch(() =&gt; {})
+ }
+ 
+ // 导入
+ const handleImport = () =&gt; {
+   importFile.value = null
+   importDialogVisible.value = true
+ }
+ 
+ const handleFileChange = (file) =&gt; {
+   importFile.value = file.raw
+ }
+ 
+ const handleImportSubmit = async () =&gt; {
+   if (!importFile.value) {
+     ElMessage.warning(&#39;请先选择文件&#39;)
+     return
+   }
+   importLoading.value = true
+   try {
+     const formData = new FormData()
+     formData.append(&#39;file&#39;, importFile.value)
+     const res = await importCollectionBooks(formData)
+     if (res.code === 200) {
+       const { successCount, errorCount, errors } = res.data
+       if (errorCount &gt; 0) {
+         ElMessage.warning(&#96;导入完成：成功 ${successCount} 条，失败 ${errorCount} 条&#96;)
+         console.log(&#39;导入错误详情:&#39;, errors)
+       } else {
+         ElMessage.success(&#96;导入成功：${successCount} 条&#96;)
+       }
+       importDialogVisible.value = false
+       loadData()
+     }
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;导入失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;导入失败&#39;)
+   } finally {
+     importLoading.value = false
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 导出
+ const handleExport = async () =&gt; {
+   try {
+     const params = { ...searchForm }
+     const res = await exportCollectionBooks(params)
+     // 创建下载链接
+     const blob = new Blob([res], { type: &#39;application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet&#39; })
+     const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
+     const link = document.createElement(&#39;a&#39;)
+     link.href = url
+     link.download = &#96;馆藏图书_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.xlsx&#96;
+     link.click()
+     window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
+     ElMessage.success(&#39;导出成功&#39;)
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;导出失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;导出失败&#39;)
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 下载模板
+ const handleDownloadTemplate = async () =&gt; {
+   try {
+     const res = await downloadCollectionBookTemplate()
+     const blob = new Blob([res], { type: &#39;application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet&#39; })
+     const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
+     const link = document.createElement(&#39;a&#39;)
+     link.href = url
+     link.download = &#39;馆藏图书导入模板.xlsx&#39;
+     link.click()
+     window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
+     ElMessage.success(&#39;模板下载成功&#39;)
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;下载模板失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;下载模板失败&#39;)
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 标记为问题图书
+ const handleMarkProblem = (row) =&gt; {
+   markProblemForm.barcode = row.barcode
+   markProblemForm.problemType = &#39;&#39;
+   markProblemForm.problemReason = &#39;&#39;
+   markProblemDialogVisible.value = true
+ }
+ 
+ const handleMarkProblemSubmit = async () =&gt; {
+   markProblemLoading.value = true
+   try {
+     await markAsProblem(markProblemForm.barcode, markProblemForm.problemType, markProblemForm.problemReason)
+     ElMessage.success(&#39;已标记为问题图书&#39;)
+     markProblemDialogVisible.value = false
+     loadData()
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;标记失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;标记失败&#39;)
+   } finally {
+     markProblemLoading.value = false
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 初始化
+ onMounted(() =&gt; {
+   loadData()
+ })
+ &lt;/script&gt;
```

```diff
+ import { ref, reactive, onMounted } from &#39;vue&#39;

+   problemType: &#39;&#39;,
+   branchLibrary: &#39;&#39;,
+   isProblem: 1  // 只查询问题图书
+ })
+ 
+ // 分页
+ const pagination = reactive({
+   pageNum: 1,
+   pageSize: 10,
+   total: 0
+ })
+ 
+ // 表格数据
+ const tableData = ref([])
+ const loading = ref(false)
+ const selectedRows = ref([])
+ 
+ // 详情对话框
+ const detailDialogVisible = ref(false)
+ const detailData = ref({})
+ 
+ // 格式化日期时间
+ const formatDateTime = (dateTime) =&gt; {
+   if (!dateTime) return &#39;-&#39;
+   const date = new Date(dateTime)
+   return date.toLocaleString(&#39;zh-CN&#39;, {
+     year: &#39;numeric&#39;,
+     month: &#39;2-digit&#39;,
+     day: &#39;2-digit&#39;,
+     hour: &#39;2-digit&#39;,
+     minute: &#39;2-digit&#39;
+   })
+ }
+ 
+ // 加载列表数据
+ const loadData = async () =&gt; {
+   loading.value = true
+   try {
+     const params = {
+       ...searchForm,
+       pageNum: pagination.pageNum,
+       pageSize: pagination.pageSize
+     }
+     const res = await getCollectionBookList(params)
+     if (res.code === 200) {
+       tableData.value = res.data.records || []
+       pagination.total = res.data.total || 0
+     }
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;加载数据失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;加载数据失败&#39;)
+   } finally {
+     loading.value = false
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 搜索
+ const handleSearch = () =&gt; {
+   pagination.pageNum = 1
+   loadData()
+ }
+ 
+ // 重置搜索
+ const handleReset = () =&gt; {
+   searchForm.barcode = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.bookName = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.author = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.isbn = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.publisher = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.problemType = &#39;&#39;
+   searchForm.branchLibrary = &#39;&#39;
+   handleSearch()
+ }
+ 
+ // 分页
+ const handleSizeChange = (val) =&gt; {
+   pagination.pageSize = val
+   loadData()
+ }
+ 
+ const handleCurrentChange = (val) =&gt; {
+   pagination.pageNum = val
+   loadData()
+ }
+ 
+ // 多选
+ const handleSelectionChange = (selection) =&gt; {
+   selectedRows.value = selection
+ }
+ 
+ // 查看详情
+ const handleView = (row) =&gt; {
+   detailData.value = { ...row }
+   detailDialogVisible.value = true
+ }
+ 
+ // 恢复为正常馆藏
+ const handleRestore = (row) =&gt; {
+   ElMessageBox.confirm(&#96;确定要将条码为&quot;${row.barcode}&quot;的图书恢复为正常馆藏吗？&#96;, &#39;提示&#39;, {
+     confirmButtonText: &#39;确定&#39;,
+     cancelButtonText: &#39;取消&#39;,
+     type: &#39;info&#39;
+   }).then(async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       await markAsNormal(row.barcode)
+       ElMessage.success(&#39;已恢复为正常馆藏&#39;)
+       loadData()
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error(&#39;恢复失败:&#39;, error)
+       ElMessage.error(&#39;恢复失败&#39;)
+     }
+   }).catch(() =&gt; {})
+ }
+ 
+ // 从详情对话框恢复
+ const handleRestoreFromDetail = () =&gt; {
+   handleRestore(detailData.value)
+   detailDialogVisible.value = false
+ }
+ 
+ // 删除
+ const handleDelete = (row) =&gt; {
+   ElMessageBox.confirm(&#96;确定要删除条码为&quot;${row.barcode}&quot;的图书吗？&#96;, &#39;提示&#39;, {
+     confirmButtonText: &#39;确定&#39;,
+     cancelButtonText: &#39;取消&#39;,
+     type: &#39;warning&#39;
+   }).then(async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       await deleteCollectionBook(row.barcode)
+       ElMessage.success(&#39;删除成功&#39;)
+       loadData()
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error(&#39;删除失败:&#39;, error)
+       ElMessage.error(&#39;删除失败&#39;)
+     }
+   }).catch(() =&gt; {})
+ }
+ 
+ // 批量删除
+ const handleBatchDelete = () =&gt; {
+   if (selectedRows.value.length === 0) {
+     ElMessage.warning(&#39;请先选择要删除的数据&#39;)
+     return
+   }
+   ElMessageBox.confirm(&#96;确定要删除选中的 ${selectedRows.value.length} 条数据吗？&#96;, &#39;提示&#39;, {
+     confirmButtonText: &#39;确定&#39;,
+     cancelButtonText: &#39;取消&#39;,
+     type: &#39;warning&#39;
+   }).then(async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const barcodes = selectedRows.value.map(item =&gt; item.barcode)
+       await deleteBatchCollectionBooks(barcodes)
+       ElMessage.success(&#39;批量删除成功&#39;)
+       loadData()
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error(&#39;批量删除失败:&#39;, error)
+       ElMessage.error(&#39;批量删除失败&#39;)
+     }
+   }).catch(() =&gt; {})
+ }
+ 
+ // 导出
+ const handleExport = async () =&gt; {
+   try {
+     const params = { ...searchForm }
+     const res = await exportCollectionBooks(params)
+     const blob = new Blob([res], { type: &#39;application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet&#39; })
+     const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
+     const link = document.createElement(&#39;a&#39;)
+     link.href = url
+     link.download = &#96;馆藏问题图书_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.xlsx&#96;
+     link.click()
+     window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
+     ElMessage.success(&#39;导出成功&#39;)
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;导出失败:&#39;, error)
+     ElMessage.error(&#39;导出失败&#39;)
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 初始化
+ onMounted(() =&gt; {
+   loadData()
+ })
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ 
+ &lt;style scoped&gt;
+ .collection-problem-book-list {
+   padding: 20px;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-header {
+   margin-bottom: 20px;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-header h2 {
+   margin: 0 0 8px 0;
+   font-size: 20px;
+   font-weight: 600;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-header .description {
+   margin: 0;
+   color: #909399;
+   font-size: 14px;
+ }
+ 
+ .search-card {
+   margin-bottom: 20px;
+ }
+ 
+ .search-form {
+   display: flex;
+   flex-wrap: wrap;
+   gap: 10px;
+ }
+ 
+ .table-card {
+   margin-bottom: 20px;
+ }
+ 
+ .card-header {
+   display: flex;
+   justify-content: space-between;
+   align-items: center;
+ }
+ 
+ .header-actions {
+   display: flex;
+   gap: 10px;
+ }
+ 
+ .pagination-container {
+   margin-top: 20px;
+   display: flex;
+   justify-content: flex-end;
+ }
+ &lt;/style&gt;
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

### 📊 数据库表字段设计

| 字段名 | 中文名 | 类型 | 说明 |
|--------|--------|------|------|
| barcode | 条码 | VARCHAR(50) | **主键** |
| book_name | 题名 | VARCHAR(500) | 必填 |
| author | 著者 | VARCHAR(200) | |
| isbn | ISBN | VARCHAR(20) | |
| publisher | 出版社 | VARCHAR(200) | |
| publish_year | 出版年 | VARCHAR(10) | |
| branch_library | 分馆 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| call_number | 索书号 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| price | 单价 | DECIMAL(10,2) | |
| batch | 批次 | VARCHAR(50) | |
| is_stored | 是否入库 | TINYINT | 0-否，1-是 |
| library_location | 馆藏院舍 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| shelf_location | 书架位置 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| duplicate_flag | 重复标记 | TINYINT | 0-否，1-是 |
| is_problem | 是否问题图书 | TINYINT | 0-正常，1-问题 |
| problem_type | 问题类型 | VARCHAR(100) | |
| problem_reason | 问题原因 | TEXT | |

### 🚀 使用步骤

**1. 执行数据库脚本**

```bash
# 进入数据库，执行 SQL 脚本
mysql -u root -p library_management < library-management-backend/src/main/resources/db/collection_books_schema.sql
```

**2. 启动后端**

```bash
cd library-management-backend
./mvnw spring-boot:run
```

**3. 启动前端**

```bash
cd library-management-frontend
npm run dev
```

**4. 访问系统**

- 前端：http://localhost:5173
- 后端 API 文档：http://localhost:8080/api/doc.html

```diff
+ 
+ import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
+ import lombok.Builder;
+ import lombok.Data;
+ import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
+ 
+ /**
+  * 敏感词命中详情 DTO
+  * 用于记录具体命中的字段、关键词和原因
+  *
+  * @author Library Management System
+  * @since 2025-12-05
+  */
+ @Data
+ @Builder
+ @NoArgsConstructor
+ @AllArgsConstructor
+ public class SensitiveHitDetailDTO {
+ 
+     /**
+      * 命中的字段名称
+      * 如：书名、著者、著者1、著者2、副题名、出版社、内容简介等
+      */
+     private String fieldName;
+ 
+     /**
+      * 命中的关键词
+      */
+     private String keyword;
+ 
+     /**
+      * 原因/警告信息
+      * 来自敏感词的 alert_message 字段
+      */
+     private String reason;
+ 
+     /**
+      * 检测类型
+      * 如：关键词、书名、作者
+      */
+     private String detectionType;
+ 
+     /**
+      * 风险等级
+      * 1-低，2-中，3-高
+      */
+     private Integer riskLevel;
+ 
+     /**
+      * 生成显示文本
+      * 格式：字段名匹配到关键词：xxx（原因：yyy）
+      */
+     public String toDisplayText() {
+         StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
+         sb.append(fieldName).append(&quot;匹配到关键词：&quot;).append(keyword);
+         if (reason != null &amp;&amp; !reason.isEmpty()) {
+             sb.append(&quot;（原因：&quot;).append(reason).append(&quot;）&quot;);
+         }
+         return sb.toString();
+     }
+ }
+
```

```diff
+     private String generateDetailRemark(CheckResultDetailDTO dto) {

+         if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(dto.getHitSensitive())) {
+             remark.append(&quot;【敏感词】&quot;);
+             if (dto.getSensitiveHitDetails() != null &amp;&amp; !dto.getSensitiveHitDetails().isEmpty()) {

+                         .map(SensitiveHitDetailDTO::toDisplayText)
+                         .collect(Collectors.toList());
+                 remark.append(String.join(&quot;；&quot;, detailTexts));
+             } else if (StringUtils.hasText(dto.getSensitiveWords())) {
+                 // 使用简单格式
+                 remark.append(&quot;命中敏感词：&quot;).append(dto.getSensitiveWords());
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // 问题书目
+         if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(dto.getHitProblemBook())) {
+             if (remark.length() &gt; 0) {
+                 remark.append(&quot; | &quot;);
+             }
+             remark.append(&quot;【问题书目】&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         // 非白名单
+         if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(dto.getIsWhitelistPublisher())) {
+             if (remark.length() &gt; 0) {
+                 remark.append(&quot; | &quot;);
+             }
+             remark.append(&quot;【非白名单出版社】&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         if (remark.length() == 0) {
+             remark.append(&quot;无问题&quot;);
+         }
+ 
+         return remark.toString();
      }
```

```
          &lt;span style=&quot;color: #67c23a&quot;&gt;{{ importResult.successCount || 0 }}&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/el-descriptions-item&gt;
        &lt;el-descriptions-item label=&quot;失败&quot;&gt;
          &lt;span style=&quot;color: #f56c6c&quot;&gt;{{ importResult.errorCount || 0 }}&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/el-descriptions-item&gt;

&lt;script setup&gt;
import { ref, reactive, onMounted } from &#39;vue&#39;
import { ElMessage, ElMessageBox } from &#39;element-plus&#39;
import {
  Search,
  Refresh,
  Plus,
  Edit,
  Delete,
  Upload,
  Download,
  Document,
  UploadFilled
} from &#39;@element-plus/icons-vue&#39;
import {
  getSensitiveWordList,
  deleteSensitiveWord,
  importSensitiveWords,
  exportSensitiveWords,
  downloadTemplate,
  getSensitiveWordCategories
} from &#39;@/api/sensitiveWord&#39;
import SensitiveWordForm from &#39;./SensitiveWordForm.vue&#39;

// 查询表单
const queryForm = reactive({
  pageNum: 1,
  pageSize: 10,
  keyword: &#39;&#39;,
  categoryId: null,
  createdBy: &#39;&#39;
})

// 表格数据
const tableData = ref([])
const total = ref(0)
const loading = ref(false)

// 对话框状�?const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const isEdit = ref(false)
const currentWord = ref({})

// 批量导入相关
const importDialogVisible = ref(false)
const importLoading = ref(false)
const uploadRef = ref(null)
const uploadFile = ref(null)

// 导入结果对话�?const importResultDialogVisible = ref(false)
const importResult = ref({})

// 敏感词类别列�?const categoryList = ref([])

/**
 * 获取风险等级对应�?Tag 类型
 */
const getRiskLevelType = (level) =&gt; {
  const map = {
    1: &#39;success&#39;, // 低风�?- 绿色
    2: &#39;warning&#39;, // 中风�?- 黄色
    3: &#39;danger&#39;   // 高风�?- 红色
  }
  return map[level] || &#39;info&#39;
}

/**
 * 获取风险等级显示的文�? */
const getRiskLevelText = (level) =&gt; {
  const map = {
    1: &#39;低风�?,
    2: &#39;中风�?,
    3: &#39;高风�?
  }
  return map[level] || &#39;未知&#39;
}

/**
 * 加载敏感词列�? */
const loadSensitiveWordList = async () =&gt; {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const response = await getSensitiveWordList(queryForm)
    if (response.code === 200) {
      tableData.value = response.data.records
      total.value = response.data.total
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;加载敏感词列表失�?&#39;, error)
    ElMessage.error(&#39;加载敏感词列表失�?)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

/**
 * 查询按钮点击
 */
const handleQuery = () =&gt; {
  queryForm.pageNum = 1
  loadSensitiveWordList()
}

/**
 * 重置按钮点击
 */
const handleReset = () =&gt; {
  queryForm.pageNum = 1
  queryForm.pageSize = 10
  queryForm.keyword = &#39;&#39;
  queryForm.categoryId = null
  queryForm.createdBy = &#39;&#39;
  loadSensitiveWordList()
}

/**
 * 新增敏感�? */
const handleAdd = () =&gt; {
  isEdit.value = false
  currentWord.value = {}
  dialogVisible.value = true
}

/**
 * 编辑敏感�? */
const handleEdit = (row) =&gt; {
  isEdit.value = true
  currentWord.value = { ...row }
  dialogVisible.value = true
}

/**
 * 删除敏感�? */
const handleDelete = async (row) =&gt; {
  try {
    await ElMessageBox.confirm(
      &#96;确定要删除敏感词&quot;${row.keyword}&quot;吗？&#96;,
      &#39;删除确认&#39;,
      {
        confirmButtonText: &#39;确定&#39;,
        cancelButtonText: &#39;取消&#39;,
        type: &#39;warning&#39;
      }
    )

    const response = await deleteSensitiveWord(row.wordId)
    if (response.code === 200) {
      ElMessage.success(&#39;删除成功&#39;)
      loadSensitiveWordList()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error !== &#39;cancel&#39;) {
      console.error(&#39;删除敏感词失�?&#39;, error)
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 批量导入
 */
const handleImport = () =&gt; {
  uploadFile.value = null
  importDialogVisible.value = true
}

/**
 * 文件选择变化
 */
const handleFileChange = (file) =&gt; {
  uploadFile.value = file.raw
}

/**
 * 文件超出限制
 */
const handleExceed = () =&gt; {
  ElMessage.warning(&#39;只能上传一个文�?)
}

/**
 * 确认导入
 */
const confirmImport = async () =&gt; {
  if (!uploadFile.value) {
    ElMessage.warning(&#39;请选择要导入的文件&#39;)
    return
  }

  // 检查文件大小（10MB�?  if (uploadFile.value.size &gt; 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
    ElMessage.error(&#39;文件大小不能超过 10MB&#39;)
    return
  }

  importLoading.value = true
  try {
    const formData = new FormData()
    formData.append(&#39;file&#39;, uploadFile.value)

    const response = await importSensitiveWords(formData)
    if (response.code === 200) {
      importResult.value = response.data
      importDialogVisible.value = false
      importResultDialogVisible.value = true

      // 重置到第1页并刷新列表（解决批量导入后的分页问题）
      queryForm.pageNum = 1
      loadSensitiveWordList()

      // 清空上传组件
      uploadRef.value?.clearFiles()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;导入敏感词失�?&#39;, error)
    ElMessage.error(&#39;导入失败，请检查文件格�?)
  } finally {
    importLoading.value = false
  }
}

/**
 * 批量导出
 */
const handleExport = async () =&gt; {
  try {
    ElMessage.info(&#39;正在导出，请稍�?..&#39;)

    const response = await exportSensitiveWords(queryForm)

    // 创建下载链接
    const blob = new Blob([response], {
      type: &#39;application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet&#39;
    })
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const link = document.createElement(&#39;a&#39;)
    link.href = url
    link.download = &#96;敏感词列表_${new Date().getTime()}.xlsx&#96;
    link.click()
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)

    ElMessage.success(&#39;导出成功&#39;)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;导出敏感词失�?&#39;, error)
    ElMessage.error(&#39;导出失败&#39;)
  }
}

/**
 * 下载模板
 */
const handleDownloadTemplate = async () =&gt; {
  try {
    ElMessage.info(&#39;正在下载模板，请稍�?..&#39;)

    const response = await downloadTemplate()

    // 创建下载链接
    const blob = new Blob([response], {
      type: &#39;application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet&#39;
    })
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const link = document.createElement(&#39;a&#39;)
    link.href = url
    link.download = &#39;敏感词导入模�?xlsx&#39;
    link.click()
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)

    ElMessage.success(&#39;模板下载成功&#39;)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;下载模板失败:&#39;, error)
    ElMessage.error(&#39;模板下载失败&#39;)
  }
}

/**
 * 表单操作成功回调
 */
const handleSuccess = () =&gt; {
  dialogVisible.value = false
  // 新增成功后重置到�?页（解决新增后的分页问题�?  if (!isEdit.value) {
    queryForm.pageNum = 1
  }
  loadSensitiveWordList()
}

/**
 * 每页数量变化
 */
const handleSizeChange = (val) =&gt; {
  queryForm.pageSize = val
  queryForm.pageNum = 1  // 重置到第1�?  loadSensitiveWordList()
}

/**
 * 当前页变�? */
const handleCurrentChange = (val) =&gt; {
  queryForm.pageNum = val
  loadSensitiveWordList()
}

/**
 * 格式化日期时间为 YY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
 */
const formatDateTime = (dateTime) =&gt; {
  if (!dateTime) return &#39;-&#39;
  const date = new Date(dateTime)
  const year = String(date.getFullYear()).slice(-2) // 取后两位年份
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, &#39;0&#39;)
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, &#39;0&#39;)
  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, &#39;0&#39;)
  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, &#39;0&#39;)
  const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, &#39;0&#39;)
  return &#96;${year}-${month}-${day} ${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds}&#96;
}

/**
 * 加载敏感词分类列�? */
const loadCategories = async () =&gt; {
  try {
    const response = await getSensitiveWordCategories()
    if (response.code === 200) {
      categoryList.value = response.data
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;加载分类列表失败:&#39;, error)
    ElMessage.error(&#39;加载分类列表失败&#39;)
  }
}

// 页面加载时获取数�?onMounted(() =&gt; {
  loadCategories()
  loadSensitiveWordList()
})
&lt;/script&gt;
```

```
import { ref, reactive, watch, nextTick, onMounted } from &#39;vue&#39;
import { ElMessage } from &#39;element-plus&#39;
import { createSensitiveWord, updateSensitiveWord, getSensitiveWordCategories } from &#39;@/api/sensitiveWord&#39;

// Props
const props = defineProps({
  visible: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false
  },
  formData: {
    type: Object,
    default: () =&gt; ({})
  },
  isEdit: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false
  }
})

// Emits

// 对话框显示状�?const dialogVisible = ref(props.visible)

// 敏感词类别列�?const categoryList = ref([])

// 表单验证规则
const rules = {
  keyword: [
    { required: true, message:
          &#39;请输入敏感词内容&#39;, trigger: &#39;blur&#39; },
    { min: 1, max: 100, message:
          &#39;敏感词内容长度在1-100个字�?, trigger:
          &#39;blur&#39; }
  ],
  categoryId: [
    { required: true, message:
          &#39;请选择敏感词类�?, trigger: &#39;change&#39; }
  ]
}
/**
 * 加载分类列表
 */
const loadCategories = async () =&gt; {
  try {
    const response = await getSensitiveWordCategories()
    if (response.code === 200) {
      console.log(&#39;�?分类列表:&#39;, categoryList.value)
      categoryList.value = response.data
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;加载分类列表失败:&#39;, error)
    ElMessage.error(&#39;加载分类列表失败&#39;)
  }
}

/**
 * 监听 visible 变化
 */
watch(() =&gt; props.visible, (val) =&gt; {
  dialogVisible.value = val
  if (val) {
    // 对话框打开时，初始化表单数�?    nextTick(() =&gt; {
      if (props.isEdit) {
        // 编辑模式：填充数�?        Object.assign(form, {
          wordId: props.formData.wordId,
          keyword: props.formData.keyword,
          categoryId: props.formData.categoryId
        })
      } else {
        // 新增模式：重置表�?        resetForm()
      }
    })
  }
})

/**
 * 监听对话框显示状态变�? */
watch(dialogVisible, (val) =&gt; {
  emit(&#39;update:visible&#39;, val)
})

/**
 * 重置表单
 */
const resetForm = () =&gt; {
  Object.assign(form, {
    wordId: null,
    keyword: &#39;&#39;,
    categoryId: null
  })
  formRef.value?.clearValidate()
}

/**
 * 关闭对话�? */
const handleClose = () =&gt; {
  dialogVisible.value = false
  resetForm()
}

/**
 * 提交表单
 */
const handleSubmit = async () =&gt; {
  // 表单验证
  const valid = await formRef.value.validate().catch(() =&gt; false)
  if (!valid) {
    return
  }

  submitLoading.value = true
  try {
    let response
    if (props.isEdit) {
      // 编辑敏感�?      const updateData = {
        wordId: form.wordId,
        keyword: form.keyword,
        categoryId: form.categoryId
      }
      response = await updateSensitiveWord(updateData)
    } else {
      // 新增敏感�?      console.log(&#39;📝 当前表单数据:&#39;, form)
      console.log(&#39;📝 form.categoryId 类型:&#39;, typeof form.categoryId)
      const createData = {
        keyword: form.keyword,
        categoryId: form.categoryId
      }
      console.log(&#39;📤 准备提交的数�?&#39;, createData)
      response = await createSensitiveWord(createData)
    }

    if (response.code === 200) {
      ElMessage.success(props.isEdit ? &#39;修改成功&#39; : &#39;新增成功&#39;)
      emit(&#39;success&#39;)
      handleClose()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(&#39;提交失败:&#39;, error)
  } finally {
    submitLoading.value = false
  }
}
// 组件挂载时加载分类列�?onMounted(() =&gt; {
  loadCategories()
})
&lt;/script&gt;
```

```
package com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.service.impl;

import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.LambdaQueryWrapper;
import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.plugins.pagination.Page;
import com.library.management.common.exception.BusinessException;
import com.library.management.common.utils.ExcelUtil;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.dto.SensitiveWordCreateRequest;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.dto.SensitiveWordDTO;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.dto.SensitiveWordExcelDTO;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.dto.SensitiveWordQueryRequest;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.dto.SensitiveWordUpdateRequest;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.entity.SensitiveWords;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.mapper.SensitiveWordMapper;
import com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.service.SensitiveWordService;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * 敏感词服务实现类
 *
 * @Service: Spring 服务层注解，标记为业务逻辑组件
 * @RequiredArgsConstructor: Lombok 注解，自动生成包�?final 字段的构造函数（用于依赖注入�? * @Slf4j: Lombok 注解，自动生成日志对�? *
 * @author Library Management System
 * @since 2025-10-21
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SensitiveWordServiceImpl implements SensitiveWordService {

    private final SensitiveWordMapper sensitiveWordMapper;
    private final com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.mapper.SensitiveCategoryMapper sensitiveCategoryMapper;

    /**
     * 分页查询敏感词列�?     *
     * 使用 MyBatis-Plus �?LambdaQueryWrapper 构建查询条件
     * - like: 模糊查询
     * - eq: 精确查询
     */
    @Override
    public Page&lt;SensitiveWordDTO&gt; queryWords(SensitiveWordQueryRequest request) {
        // 创建分页对象
        Page&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; page = new Page&lt;&gt;(request.getPageNum(), request.getPageSize());

        // 构建查询条件
        LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();

        // 敏感词内容模糊查�?        if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getKeyword())) {
            wrapper.like(SensitiveWords::getKeyword, request.getKeyword());
        }

        // 分类ID精确查询
        if (request.getCategoryId() != null) {
            wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getCategoryId, request.getCategoryId());
        }

        // 匹配类型精确查询
        if (request.getMatchType() != null) {
            wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getMatchType, request.getMatchType());
        }

        // 风险等级精确查询
        if (request.getRiskLevel() != null) {
            wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getRiskLevel, request.getRiskLevel());
        }

        // 是否启用精确查询
        if (request.getIsActive() != null) {
            wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getIsActive, request.getIsActive());
        }

        // 按创建时间倒序排序
        wrapper.orderByDesc(SensitiveWords::getCreateTime);

        // 执行分页查询
        Page&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; wordPage = sensitiveWordMapper.selectPage(page, wrapper);

        // 转换�?DTO
        Page&lt;SensitiveWordDTO&gt; dtoPage = new Page&lt;&gt;(wordPage.getCurrent(), wordPage.getSize(), wordPage.getTotal());
        dtoPage.setRecords(wordPage.getRecords().stream()
                .map(this::convertToDTO)
                .toList());

        return dtoPage;
    }

    /**
     * 根据ID查询敏感词详�?     */
    @Override
    public SensitiveWordDTO getWordById(Long wordId) {
        SensitiveWords word = sensitiveWordMapper.selectById(wordId);
        if (word == null) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词不存在&quot;);
        }
        return convertToDTO(word);
    }

    /**
     * 创建新敏感词
     *
     * 业务逻辑�?     * 1. 验证分类ID是否存在
     * 2. 检查敏感词内容是否已存�?     * 3. 创建敏感词对象并保存到数据库
     *
     * @CacheEvict 注解�?     * - 方法执行后清除指定缓�?     * - cacheNames：缓存名�?     * - allEntries = true：清除该缓存下的所有条�?     */
    @Override
    @CacheEvict(cacheNames = &quot;sensitiveWords&quot;, allEntries = true)
    public SensitiveWordDTO createWord(SensitiveWordCreateRequest request, Long createdBy) {
        // 1. 验证分类ID是否存在
        var category = sensitiveCategoryMapper.selectById(request.getCategoryId());
        if (category == null) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词分类不存在&quot;);
        }

        // 2. 检查敏感词是否已存�?        SensitiveWords existingWord = sensitiveWordMapper.selectByKeyword(request.getKeyword());
        if (existingWord != null) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词已存在&quot;);
        }

        // 3. 创建敏感词对�?        SensitiveWords word = SensitiveWords.builder()
                .keyword(request.getKeyword())
                .categoryId(request.getCategoryId())
                .matchType(request.getMatchType())
                .riskLevel(request.getRiskLevel())
                .isActive(request.getIsActive())
                .createdBy(createdBy)
                .build();

        // 4. 保存到数据库
        int rows = sensitiveWordMapper.insert(word);
        if (rows == 0) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;创建敏感词失�?);
        }

        // 5. 返回敏感词信�?        return convertToDTO(word);
    }

    /**
     * 修改敏感词信�?     *
     * 业务逻辑�?     * 1. 检查敏感词是否存在
     * 2. 如果修改分类ID，验证分类是否存�?     * 3. 如果修改敏感词内容，检查新内容是否已被其他敏感词占�?     * 4. 更新敏感词信息（只更新非空字段）
     *
     * @CacheEvict：修改后清除缓存
     */
    @Override
    @CacheEvict(cacheNames = &quot;sensitiveWords&quot;, allEntries = true)
    public SensitiveWordDTO updateWord(SensitiveWordUpdateRequest request, Long updatedBy) {
        // 1. 检查敏感词是否存在
        SensitiveWords word = sensitiveWordMapper.selectById(request.getWordId());
        if (word == null) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词不存在&quot;);
        }

        // 2. 如果修改了分类ID，验证分类是否存�?        if (request.getCategoryId() != null) {
            var category = sensitiveCategoryMapper.selectById(request.getCategoryId());
            if (category == null) {
                throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词分类不存在&quot;);
            }
            word.setCategoryId(request.getCategoryId());
        }

        // 3. 如果修改了敏感词内容，检查新内容是否已被其他敏感词占�?        if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getKeyword()) &amp;&amp; !request.getKeyword().equals(word.getKeyword())) {
            SensitiveWords existingWord = sensitiveWordMapper.selectByKeyword(request.getKeyword());
            if (existingWord != null) {
                throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词已被占�?);
            }
            word.setKeyword(request.getKeyword());
        }

        // 4. 更新其他字段（只更新非空字段�?        if (request.getMatchType() != null) {
            word.setMatchType(request.getMatchType());
        }
        if (request.getRiskLevel() != null) {
            word.setRiskLevel(request.getRiskLevel());
        }
        if (request.getIsActive() != null) {
            word.setIsActive(request.getIsActive());
        }

        // 5. 设置更新人和更新时间
        word.setUpdatedBy(updatedBy);
        word.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());

        // 6. 保存到数据库
        int rows = sensitiveWordMapper.updateById(word);
        if (rows == 0) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;修改敏感词失�?);
        }

        // 7. 返回修改后的敏感词信�?        return convertToDTO(word);
    }

    /**
     * 删除敏感�?     *
     * 业务逻辑�?     * 1. 检查敏感词是否存在
     * 2. 执行物理删除（从数据库中删除记录�?     *
     * @CacheEvict：删除后清除缓存
     */
    @Override
    @CacheEvict(cacheNames = &quot;sensitiveWords&quot;, allEntries = true)
    public void deleteWord(Long wordId) {
        // 1. 检查敏感词是否存在
        SensitiveWords word = sensitiveWordMapper.selectById(wordId);
        if (word == null) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;敏感词不存在&quot;);
        }

        // 2. 执行删除
        int rows = sensitiveWordMapper.deleteById(wordId);
        if (rows == 0) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;删除敏感词失�?);
        }
    }

    /**
     * 批量导入敏感词（更新�?- 适配新模板）
     *
     * 业务逻辑�?     * 1. 读取 Excel 文件（新格式：类型、关键词、警报信息）
     * 2. 校验数据（必填字段检查、类型校验、重复性检查）
     * 3. 批量插入数据�?     * 4. 返回导入结果统计
     *
     * 新模板列结构�?     * - 类型（关键词/书名/作者）
     * - 关键�?     * - 警报信息
     *
     * @CacheEvict：导入后清除缓存
     */
    @Override
    @CacheEvict(cacheNames = &quot;sensitiveWords&quot;, allEntries = true)
    public Map&lt;String, Object&gt; importWords(MultipartFile file, Long createdBy) {
        // 1. 读取 Excel 文件
        List&lt;SensitiveWordExcelDTO&gt; excelDataList = ExcelUtil.read(file, SensitiveWordExcelDTO.class);

        if (excelDataList == null || excelDataList.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessException(&quot;Excel 文件为空或格式不正确&quot;);
        }

        // 2. 数据校验和转�?        List&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; successList = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
        List&lt;String&gt; errorList = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
        AtomicInteger rowIndex = new AtomicInteger(1); // 从第2行开始（�?行是表头�?
        excelDataList.forEach(excelData -&gt; {
            rowIndex.incrementAndGet();
            try {
                // 校验必填字段：类型和关键�?                if (!StringUtils.hasText(excelData.getDetectionType())) {
                    errorList.add(&quot;�?&quot; + rowIndex.get() + &quot; 行：类型不能为空（必须是：关键词、书名、作者之一�?);
                    return;
                }
                if (!StringUtils.hasText(excelData.getKeyword())) {
                    errorList.add(&quot;�?&quot; + rowIndex.get() + &quot; 行：关键词不能为�?);
                    return;
                }

                // 校验类型是否合法
                String detectionType = excelData.getDetectionType().trim();
                if (!detectionType.equals(&quot;关键�?) &amp;&amp; !detectionType.equals(&quot;书名&quot;) &amp;&amp; !detectionType.equals(&quot;作�?)) {
                    errorList.add(&quot;�?&quot; + rowIndex.get() + &quot; 行：类型�? + detectionType + &quot;」无效，必须是：关键词、书名、作者之一&quot;);
                    return;
                }

                // 检查敏感词是否已存�?                SensitiveWords existingWord = sensitiveWordMapper.selectByKeyword(excelData.getKeyword().trim());
                if (existingWord != null) {
                    errorList.add(&quot;�?&quot; + rowIndex.get() + &quot; 行：关键词�? + excelData.getKeyword() + &quot;」已存在&quot;);
                    return;
                }

                // 转换为实体对�?                SensitiveWords word = SensitiveWords.builder()
                        .keyword(excelData.getKeyword().trim())
                        .detectionType(detectionType)
                        .alertMessage(StringUtils.hasText(excelData.getAlertMessage())
                                ? excelData.getAlertMessage().trim()
                                : null)
                        .categoryId(1L)  // 默认分类ID（可根据实际情况调整�?                        .matchType(1)    // 默认模糊匹配
                        .riskLevel(2)    // 默认中风�?                        .isActive(true)  // 默认启用
                        .createdBy(createdBy)
                        .build();

                successList.add(word);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error(&quot;处理�?{} 行数据失�?, rowIndex.get(), e);
                errorList.add(&quot;�?&quot; + rowIndex.get() + &quot; 行：&quot; + e.getMessage());
            }
        });

        // 3. 批量插入数据�?        int successCount = 0;
        if (!successList.isEmpty()) {
            for (SensitiveWords word : successList) {
                try {
                    sensitiveWordMapper.insert(word);
                    successCount++;
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error(&quot;插入敏感词失�? {}&quot;, word.getKeyword(), e);
                    errorList.add(&quot;关键词�? + word.getKeyword() + &quot;」保存失败：&quot; + e.getMessage());
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. 返回导入结果统计
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; result = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        result.put(&quot;totalCount&quot;, excelDataList.size());
        result.put(&quot;successCount&quot;, successCount);
        result.put(&quot;errorCount&quot;, errorList.size());
        result.put(&quot;errorList&quot;, errorList);

        log.info(&quot;敏感词导入完成：总数 {}, 成功 {}, 失败 {}&quot;,
                excelDataList.size(), successCount, errorList.size());

        return result;
    }

    /**
     * 批量导出敏感词（更新�?- 适配新模板）
     *
     * 业务逻辑�?     * 1. 根据查询条件获取数据（如果没有条件则导出全部�?     * 2. 转换�?Excel DTO（新格式：类型、关键词、警报信息）
     * 3. 使用 ExcelUtil 写入响应�?     *
     * 导出列结构：
     * - 类型（关键词/书名/作者）
     * - 关键�?     * - 警报信息
     */
    @Override
    public void exportWords(HttpServletResponse response, SensitiveWordQueryRequest request) {
        // 1. 查询数据
        LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();

        // 如果提供了查询条件，则按条件过滤
        if (request != null) {
            if (StringUtils.hasText(request.getKeyword())) {
                wrapper.like(SensitiveWords::getKeyword, request.getKeyword());
            }
            if (request.getCategoryId() != null) {
                wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getCategoryId, request.getCategoryId());
            }
            if (request.getMatchType() != null) {
                wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getMatchType, request.getMatchType());
            }
            if (request.getRiskLevel() != null) {
                wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getRiskLevel, request.getRiskLevel());
            }
            if (request.getIsActive() != null) {
                wrapper.eq(SensitiveWords::getIsActive, request.getIsActive());
            }
        }

        wrapper.orderByDesc(SensitiveWords::getCreateTime);
        List&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; wordList = sensitiveWordMapper.selectList(wrapper);

        // 2. 转换�?Excel DTO（新格式�?        List&lt;SensitiveWordExcelDTO&gt; excelDataList = wordList.stream()
                .map(word -&gt; SensitiveWordExcelDTO.builder()
                        .detectionType(word.getDetectionType() != null ? word.getDetectionType() : &quot;关键�?)
                        .keyword(word.getKeyword())
                        .alertMessage(word.getAlertMessage())
                        .build())
                .toList();

        // 3. 导出 Excel
        ExcelUtil.write(response, excelDataList, SensitiveWordExcelDTO.class, &quot;敏感词列�?);

        log.info(&quot;敏感词导出完成，�?{} 条数�?, excelDataList.size());
    }

     *

    @Override
    public void downloadTemplate(HttpServletResponse response) {
        // 创建示例数据（参考实际敏感词数据�?        List&lt;SensitiveWordExcelDTO&gt; templateData = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();

        // 关键词类型示�?        templateData.add(SensitiveWordExcelDTO.builder()
                .detectionType(&quot;关键�?)

    /**
     * 获取所有敏感词（用于缓存）
     *
     * @Cacheable 注解�?     * - 方法执行前先查询缓存
     * - 如果缓存中有数据，直接返回，不执行方�?     * - 如果缓存中没有数据，执行方法并将结果存入缓存
     * - cacheNames：缓存名�?     * - key：缓存的 key，这里使用固定�?&quot;all&quot;
     */
    @Override
    @Cacheable(cacheNames = &quot;sensitiveWords&quot;, key = &quot;&#39;all&#39;&quot;)
    public List&lt;SensitiveWordDTO&gt; getAllWords() {
        log.info(&quot;从数据库加载所有敏感词（未命中缓存�?);

        List&lt;SensitiveWords&gt; wordList = sensitiveWordMapper.selectList(null);

        List&lt;SensitiveWordDTO&gt; dtoList = wordList.stream()
                .map(this::convertToDTO)
                .toList();

        log.info(&quot;加载敏感词完成，�?{} �?, dtoList.size());
        return dtoList;
    }

    getAllCategories() {

        // 查询所有分�?        var categories =
                sensitiveCategoryMapper.selectList(null);

        // 转换�?Map 列表，方便前端使�?        List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; result = categories.stream().map(category -&gt; {
            Map&lt;String, Object&gt;
                    map = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
            map.put(&quot;categoryId&quot;,
                    category.getCategoryId());

            map.put(&quot;categoryName&quot;,
                    category.getCategoryName());
            map.put(&quot;description&quot;,
                    category.getDescription());
            return map;
                        })
                        .toList();

        log.info(&quot;查询分类完成，共 {} �?,
                result.size());
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * 实体�?DTO（包含关联查询分类名称）
     */
    private SensitiveWordDTO convertToDTO(SensitiveWords word) {
        SensitiveWordDTO dto = new SensitiveWordDTO();
        BeanUtils.copyProperties(word, dto);

        // 关联查询分类名称
        if (word.getCategoryId() != null) {
            var category = sensitiveCategoryMapper.selectById(word.getCategoryId());
            if (category != null) {
                dto.setCategoryName(category.getCategoryName());
            }
        }

        return dto;
    }
}
```

```
package com.library.management.module.sensitiveword.dto;

import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;

/**
```

### 敏感词检测流程说明

当用户添加敏感词时：
1. 输入**敏感词内容**（如"暴力"）
2. 选择**敏感词类别**：
   - `关键词`：在所有字段中检测（书名、作者、内容简介等）
   - `作者`：仅在著者字段中检测
   - `书名`：仅在题名字段中检测
3. 输入**警报信息**：如"疑似暴力内容"

当检测命中时，会显示：
- 命中字段（如"著者1"）
- 命中关键词（如"暴力"）
- 警报原因（如"疑似暴力内容"）
